title: Record type
description: A kind of record the organisation keeps, such as a donation or a beneficiary: its fields, numbering, rules, and who can see records.

key.description: Stable name used in addresses and permissions

label.description: Name of one record, for example Donation

pluralLabel.description: Name of several records, for example Donations

description.description: Shown under the name on the Records screen

reset.description: Start again from 1 each financial year, or never

titleField.description: Field used as the record's title

visibility.description: Who can see records: everyone with access, or only their own, those shared with them, and everything for people allowed to see all

public.description: What someone who has not signed in may do. Each operation is off unless it is set. View, edit and delete apply only to the visitor's own submission.

create.description: Anyone can submit a new record

view.description: After submitting, the visitor gets a link to their own record. Requires create

edit.description: That link can change the public fields. Requires view

delete.description: That link can delete the submission. Requires view

fields.description: Fields the public form shows and accepts

thanks.description: Shown when a submit does not issue a link

catalogue.description: Search of existing records. Present means search is on

search.description: Fields the search box matches. All of fields when omitted

statusIn.description: Only records in these statuses are listed. At least one is required to publish

request.description: A result opens this public form with this reference field filled

fields.description: Fields of the record, in form order

rules.description: Checks a record must pass to be saved

when.description: Expression; the rule applies only when this is true

expression.description: Must be true for the record to save

field.description: Field the message belongs to when the rule fails

lookups.description: Values filled from an http connector in lookup mode, for example a bank's name from an IFSC code

connector.description: Http connector in lookup mode to call

inputs.description: Fields of this record type sent to the connector

map.description: Field of this record type to fill, and the connector's response value (a responseMap name, not a JSON path) it is filled from

label.description: Label shown on forms and lists

choices.description: Options for choice and multiple-choice fields

referenceType.description: Record type chosen in a reference field

calculated.description: Expression; the field is read-only and computed on save

sensitive.description: Masked unless the viewer has record:<type>:sensitive; the same as readPermission record:<type>:sensitive unless readPermission is set

personal.description: Whether erasing the person this record is about clears this field. By default text, email, phone, location, signature, file and sensitive fields are cleared; true adds a field of another type, false keeps one

readPermission.description: Who can see: without this permission the value is masked and the field cannot be filtered, sorted, totalled or grouped by

editPermission.description: Who can change: without this permission the field is read-only; not for calculated or rollup fields

searchable.description: Matched by the list's search box

placeholder.description: Grey example text shown in an empty field, for example ABCDE1234F. Not for boolean, multiple choice, file, location, signature or rich text fields

visibleWhen.description: Expression on the record being saved; when false the field is hidden and submitted values are ignored

editableWhen.description: Expression on the record as stored; when false the field cannot be changed

copyFrom.description: Filled from the record chosen in a reference field of this record type whenever that choice changes

reference.description: A reference field of this record type

field.description: The field to copy from the chosen record

follow.description: Kept equal to a source field. via is a reference or person field on this record type. When that source changes, this field is updated. It is filled by the sync, not typed, and cannot also be calculated, a rollup, or copyFrom.

via.description: A reference or person field of this record type

field.description: A field on the referenced record, or an account field (id, name, email) when via is a person field

unique.description: No two records may share a value; blanks are allowed. Text, email, phone and number fields

pattern.description: Regular expression the whole value must match, for example [A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]. Text fields

patternMessage.description: Shown under the field when the value does not match the pattern

rollup.description: Read-only number kept up to date from the records that point at this one, for example a donor's total given

recordType.description: Record type of the records counted

reference.description: Their reference field that points at this record type

measure.description: How many there are, or the total of a field

field.description: Number or money field to add up

where.description: Only records for which this expression is true, for example record.status == 'paid'

accept.description: File fields: kinds of file accepted

maxSizeMb.description: File fields: largest file in megabytes

typedCoordinates.description: Location fields: people may type coordinates instead of using the device location (default true)

typedName.description: Signature fields: ask for the signer's typed name, for someone signing on another person's device
